verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client, so brokering secure infrastructure access to resources such as Kubernetes clusters is outside its product category. Its SSH keys and SSH-based repository listing on Linux servers serve Git remote access only. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships an infrastructure-access or Kubernetes capability that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get secure infrastructure access to resources wherever they live, including Kubernetes clusters
